correctness.rationale: Tightness gives a surjective synthesis map \(T\), so \(N\ge n\); balance \(T\mathbf1=0\) rules out \(N=n\), hence \(N\ge n+1\). At equality, trace gives \(\lambda=(n+1)/n\). The pairing matrix \(A=\Phi T\) obeys \(A^2=\lambda A\), has rank n and has \(\mathbf1\) as both left and right kernel generator. Therefore \(A/\lambda\) is the projection onto \(\mathbf1^\perp\) along \(\mathbf1\), namely \(I-(n+1)^{-1}\mathbf1\mathbf1^T\), forcing diagonal 1 and off-diagonal \(-1/n\). For a normalized Hadamard matrix of order n+1, deleting its first row gives a sign matrix S with \(S\mathbf1=0\), \(SS^T=(n+1)I\); columns scaled by 1/n in \(\ell_1^n\) with their sign functionals satisfy all unit-norm, norming, balance and tightness conditions. Exact Sylvester instances were independently replayed.
